frozenTextVerbatim: **PHASE 0 — INSTRUMENT REPAIRS AND HARNESS. ~4–6 sessions. Free, and only free now:** B20's rule applies verbatim — the implementation may be repaired until the first scored observation and is frozen absolutely after it, because there is no answer to tune toward until a residual exists. Ship the ten repairs in `detector` (signed suppression; `clientTruncationCap`; turn-collapse out of the scored numerator; `repair` credited once from the last round; `wouldHaveAdded` thread-resolved and nullable; `unmatched` given a magnitude and added to `refusedRows`; the per-`requestId`-subset accessor; lineage-aware `invocationOwners`; `unitsAddedByInstallation`; `scripts/b12-run.mjs`), the b12 emitter, and the six firing negative controls of VOID 6. Un-ignore `evidence/**`. **Cost of skipping this phase: the run cannot be re-emitted, cannot be corrected, and cannot be re-adjudicated — which is exactly how B1 died.**
WHAT_THIS_IS_AND_IS_NOT: STATED FIRST. This is a DURABLE, AUDITABLE claim that PHASE 0's four frozen deliverables exist, each with a file:line a reader can check, plus an explicit list of what is NOT closed and why. It is NOT a claim that the instrument is correct, that the run will produce an answer, or that anything measured here generalises. Until this artifact existed the only assertion of PHASE 0 completeness lived in a commit message (911d8d6, 'All ten pre-conditions are now in') — which is exactly where a claim cannot be audited later.

PHASE_3_IS_NOT_A_PASS: RECORDED AS UNRESOLVED, NOT AS ANSWERED. PHASE 3 (`repair` EXPOSURE) was closed at 1 of 3 — INCONCLUSIVE on both exposures. The pre-registered rule said the manifest may not be sealed on it. Closing it anyway was the OWNER's decision, taken knowingly, and it is written here as an open question the run carries rather than as a satisfied precondition. A reader who wants to discount the run on this ground has the fact they need.

theHonestSummary: PHASE 0's four frozen deliverables are present and evidenced. The phase is CLOSED in the sense the frozen text defines — instrument repairs and harness — and in no wider sense. Three of the six negative controls' worth of confidence, the platform generality of the firing evidence, one of the ten detector repairs, and the whole of PHASE 3's premise remain open, and each is named above rather than folded into a green light.
